_comment: Proof article 4 — aged copper (the hard case). Opaque master + maskset (procedural verdigris patina). ambientCG CC0 (Metal047B) metallic base, copper-toned via the authored base_color_tint default. ⭐ Phase 71 (71.11) — WIDENED 6 -> 8 ports, and it GAINS OVERLAYS. This is §9.P5: under the corrected channel contract a maskset is a MODULATOR (R = layer-2 coverage, G/B = overlay gates), so on an article with no overlays and no layer 2 it would do NOTHING and its `maskset_blend` would be a dead control. Giving Copper the shared dust + scratches overlays gives its maskset something to GATE — and `maskset_blend` is live and semantically correct again. The verdigris bitmap stops being painted on as albedo (a deliberate, lead-accepted appearance change) and becomes what it always claimed to be: a mask.
name: Copper_Verdigris_Aged_Base_s01_v01
